offerings.name: Web search
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: Web search (all models) tool call pricing
offerings.output_type: 带引用答案与结构化 web_search_call 输出
offerings.note: Search actions incur a tool call cost; search_content_types can include image; domain filters only in Responses API.

offerings.name: Image Web search
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: Image Web search (all models) tool call pricing
offerings.note: Set search_content_types to include image; image_settings controls max_results and caption.

offerings.name: Web search preview (reasoning models, including gpt-5, o-series)
offerings.pricing: $10.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens billed at model rates.
offerings.price_basis: Web search preview (reasoning models) tool call pricing
offerings.output_type: 带引用答案与 web_search_call 输出
offerings.note: web_search_preview remains available for legacy integrations; ignores external_web_access and behaves as if true.

offerings.name: Web search preview (non-reasoning models)
offerings.pricing: $25.00 / 1k calls + Search content tokens are free.
offerings.price_basis: Web search preview (non-reasoning models) tool call pricing
offerings.output_type: 带引用答案与 web_search_call 输出
offerings.note: Search content tokens are free for this tier; for gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1-mini with non-preview web search, content tokens billed as fixed 8,000 input tokens per call.

offerings.name: gpt-5-search-api
offerings.pricing: Specialized models Search: $1.25 input, $0.125 cached input, $10.00 output per 1M tokens (model token pricing; Chat Completions search model path)
offerings.output_type: 带引用答案的搜索模型输出
offerings.note: Chat Completions only; context window 200k; chat completions search models always search before responding; responses search is a tool.
